---
name: "LoopDev: Tracks: Close"
description: "Prepare and approve closure of a LoopDev track after verifying its evidence and criteria."
argument-hint: "Track id or path"
agent: agent
---

Use the `track-governance` skill to prepare closure for the requested track. Verify each closure
criterion and summarize residual risks, deferred work, and validation evidence. Ask the user for
explicit approval before moving the file to `tracks/closed/`.
